rationale: ADRX is currently trading below both the 9-EMA ($17.27) and the session VWAP ($17.34), indicating bearish momentum, but the recent 1-minute candles show a tightening range and diminishing volume, suggesting a potential consolidation rather than a clear directional breakout.
